featured_reviews.name: soul hero
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mayur General Store may be located slightly outside the village and serves only around 20–30 households, which is why sales are limited. However, the real value of this store lies in its role as a government ration distribution center.
The elderly couple running the store (around 60 years old) does an outstanding job of distributing wheat and rice fairly and accurately, all without any external support. Their honesty, dedication, and sense of responsibility are truly admirable.
This store is an essential service for the local community and the effort put in by the couple deserves genuine appreciation and respect.
